_meta.source: Hand-curated from public 10-K disclosures, FY24 / FY25 filings
_meta.purpose: Industry benchmark for revenue_concentration M-source. Used to compute peer-relative percentile rather than fixed-threshold judgments.
_meta._methodology: Top vehicle % = largest single IDIQ/contract vehicle as % of total revenue. Top customer % = single largest customer (typically DoD). Top TO % = largest single task order. N IDIQ vehicles = active prime IDIQ vehicle count where disclosed; otherwise null.
_notes: Federal services primes commonly have 1-3 dominant IDIQ vehicles (GSA OASIS+, NETCENTS, SeaPort-NxG, Alliant 2) that aggregate 15-25% of revenue. This is the industry-standard distribution, NOT a concentration risk.
Single-task-order concentration is the real risk axis: when one TO exceeds 10% of revenue, loss-of-recompete becomes material to the issuer.

Customer concentration is dominated by DoD for defense primes (60-90% typical); this is not a 'concentration risk' in the conventional sense because DoD is a stable counterparty with statutory funding.
